{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

Distribution of cells along the top principal components for each processed
subset. Parallel coordinates and PC scores on UMAP reveal batch structure
and proliferative gradients captured by each PC.

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(GGally)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r params}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)

N_PCS      <- proc_params$n_pca_dims
cc_palette <- c("S" = "#4393c3", "G2M" = "#e41a1c", "G1" = "#999999")
```

## 1. Parallel coordinates over PCs {.tabset}

Each line is one cell; axes are the top `r N_PCS` PC embeddings. Panels coloured
by **sample**, **cell cycle phase**, and **Seurat cluster** (active identity).

::: {.panel-tabset}

## HSC

```{r pc-parcoor-hsc, fig.width=14, fig.height=15}
targets::tar_load(pca_df_hsc)
p_samp  <- plot_pc_parcoor(pca_df_hsc, "sample.name",
                            title = "HSC — by sample")
p_phase <- plot_pc_parcoor(pca_df_hsc, "Phase",
                            title   = "HSC — by cell cycle phase",
                            palette = cc_palette)
p_clust <- plot_pc_parcoor(pca_df_hsc, "cluster",
                            title = "HSC — by Seurat cluster")
p_samp / p_phase / p_clust
rm(pca_df_hsc); gc()
```

## 2. PC scores on UMAP {.tabset}

Each cell coloured by its score along each of the top `r N_PCS` PCs, projected
onto the UMAP. Blue = negative loading direction; red = positive.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## HSC

```{r pc-umap-hsc, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
targets::tar_load(pca_df_hsc)
plot_pc_umap_grid(pca_df_hsc, n_pcs = N_PCS)
rm(pca_df_hsc); gc()
```

## MNC
